editorial:
Imagine being trapped inside a building while the world outside falls apart. You follow a group of people caught in the middle of a wild takeover at Colombia's Palace of Justice. It mixes real old news clips with new acting to make you feel like you are actually there. The vibe is heavy and stressful, but it keeps you glued to the screen because you never know who is going to make it out alive. You get to see how a few people's beliefs can lead to total chaos for everyone else involved.

The acting is top-notch and makes the panic feel real, though the middle part slows down a bit too much for some. If you like stories based on true events that make you think, you will love this. Just be ready for a heavy mood when you press play.
endingExplained: The movie ends with the building in ruins and most of the characters dead. You see the final clash between the soldiers and the rebels, where it becomes clear that no one really won. The final scene shows a survivor years later, looking at the rebuilt palace. It reveals that the government hid many of the truth about the missing people, leaving the families with no real answers or peace.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves true crime and historical dramas.
